\section[(dialogue)]{Times of day and the week — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R99-first-pass-times-of-day-and-the-week}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for intelligence and knowledge.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the late afternoon, dawn, midnight, the day after tomorrow, yesterday
  \item tomorrow, Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday
  \item Saturday, Sunday, every day, daily, winter; cold
  \item spring, late autumn, a second, the beginning, nowadays
  \item these days, night-time, often, ever, soon
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The late afternoon? (\textbf{\bn{বিকেল}}, \emph{bikel}.) Dawn? (\textbf{\bn{ভোর}}, \emph{bhor}.) Midnight? (\textbf{\bn{মাঝরাত}}, \emph{mājhrāt}.) The day after tomorrow? (\textbf{\bn{পরশু}}, \emph{pôrshu}.) Yesterday? (\textbf{\bn{গতকাল}}, \emph{gôtôkāl}.) Tomorrow? (\textbf{\bn{আগামীকাল}}, \emph{āgāmikāl}.) Monday? (\textbf{\bn{সোমবার}}, \emph{sombār}.) Wednesday? (\textbf{\bn{বুধবার}}, \emph{budhbār}.) Thursday? (\textbf{\bn{বৃহস্পতিবার}}, \emph{brihôspôtibār}.) Friday? (\textbf{\bn{শুক্রবার}}, \emph{shukrôbār}.) Saturday? (\textbf{\bn{শনিবার}}, \emph{shônibār}.) Sunday? (\textbf{\bn{রবিবার}}, \emph{rôbibār}.) Every day? (\textbf{\bn{প্রতিদিন}}, \emph{prôtidin}.) Daily? (\textbf{\bn{রোজ}}, \emph{roj}.) Winter; cold? (\textbf{\bn{শীত}}, \emph{shīt}.) Spring? (\textbf{\bn{বসন্ত}}, \emph{bôsôntô}.) Late autumn? (\textbf{\bn{হেমন্ত}}, \emph{hemôntô}.) A second? (\textbf{\bn{সেকেন্ড}}, \emph{sekend}.) The beginning? (\textbf{\bn{শুরু}}, \emph{shuru}.) Nowadays? (\textbf{\bn{আজকাল}}, \emph{ājkāl}.) These days? (\textbf{\bn{দিনকাল}}, \emph{dinkāl}.) Night-time? (\textbf{\bn{রাত্তির}}, \emph{rāttir}.) Often? (\textbf{\bn{প্রায়ই}}, \emph{prāyi}.) Ever? (\textbf{\bn{কখনো}}, \emph{kôkhôno}.) Soon? (\textbf{\bn{শিগগির}}, \emph{shiggir}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Wanting and having — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R99-second-pass-wanting-and-having}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for lately and all day.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item lately, all day, all night, the midday hours, the morning hours
  \item a wish, hope, a dream, a need, a necessity
  \item greed, a liking, a hobby, a pleading request, a demand
  \item to be able to, strength, a chance, an owner, land
  \item property, income, a job, intelligence, knowledge
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Lately? (\textbf{\bn{ইদানীং}}, \emph{idānīng}.) All day? (\textbf{\bn{সারাদিন}}, \emph{sārādin}.) All night? (\textbf{\bn{সারারাত}}, \emph{sārārāt}.) The midday hours? (\textbf{\bn{দুপুরবেলা}}, \emph{dupurbelā}.) The morning hours? (\textbf{\bn{সকালবেলা}}, \emph{sôkālbelā}.) A wish? (\textbf{\bn{ইচ্ছা}}, \emph{ichchhā}.) Hope? (\textbf{\bn{আশা}}, \emph{āshā}.) A dream? (\textbf{\bn{স্বপ্ন}}, \emph{shôpnô}.) A need? (\textbf{\bn{দরকার}}, \emph{dôrkār}.) A necessity? (\textbf{\bn{প্রয়োজন}}, \emph{prôyojôn}.) Greed? (\textbf{\bn{লোভ}}, \emph{lobh}.) A liking? (\textbf{\bn{পছন্দ}}, \emph{pôchhôndô}.) A hobby? (\textbf{\bn{শখ}}, \emph{shôkh}.) A pleading request? (\textbf{\bn{আবদার}}, \emph{ābdār}.) A demand? (\textbf{\bn{দাবি}}, \emph{dābi}.) To be able to? (\textbf{\bn{পারা}}, \emph{pārā}.) Strength? (\textbf{\bn{শক্তি}}, \emph{shôkti}.) A chance? (\textbf{\bn{সুযোগ}}, \emph{sujog}.) An owner? (\textbf{\bn{মালিক}}, \emph{mālik}.) Land? (\textbf{\bn{জমি}}, \emph{jômi}.) Property? (\textbf{\bn{সম্পত্তি}}, \emph{sômpôtti}.) Income? (\textbf{\bn{আয়}}, \emph{āy}.) A job? (\textbf{\bn{চাকরি}}, \emph{chākri}.) Intelligence? (\textbf{\bn{বুদ্ধি}}, \emph{buddhi}.) Knowledge? (\textbf{\bn{জ্ঞান}}, \emph{gyān}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
